title: Network Epidemic Control via Model Predictive Control: Extended Version
summary: Balancing the societal costs of non-pharmaceutical interventions with epidemic suppression requires adaptive feedback control. Rather than relying on state-dependent operational caps, we formulate an infinite-horizon optimal control problem for a networked SIQR model that strictly enforces suppression via a hard spectral constraint on the transmission dynamics. We derive a safety-critical Model Predictive Control (MPC) approximation that embeds this spectral certificate stage-wise, yielding a tunable exponential decay rate.
